title: ExperimentRunManifest
description: A single experiment RUN (not the task). Produced by the experiment layer (UI or CLI/API alike) from a task's experiment.json plus a chosen design + persona cohort. Persisted at experiments/runs/<experimentId>/manifest.json. This is where persona factors live (they are a run-level design decision, not a task property).

task.description: Repo-relative path to the experiment task dir (holds experiment.json).

sutFactors.description: Which task factor ids participate. Omitted/empty = all factors in experiment.json.

effectiveType.description: What the engine actually used (fractional may fall back to full when no orthogonal array fits).

personaFactor.description: Optional persona dimension of the design. Absent = single shared cohort with no persona contrast.

mode.description: shared_cohort: one cohort runs every SUT arm (persona is a covariate). contrast: persona base vs clone(s) is itself a factor.

paired.description: Reuse the same personas (by personaId / pair_id) across arms for within-subject comparison.

cohort.description: Base cohort definition (mirrors persona_strategy.json fields), or a $ref to the task's persona_strategy.json.

levels.description: contrast mode only: the persona arms (base + contrast clones).

pool.description: Resolved persona pool path for this arm.

personaIds.description: The resolved shared cohort persona ids (pinned so every arm runs the same personas).

cells.description: The expanded design: one entry per experiment arm/cell. Each maps to one Harbor job (job-level env carries that cell's params).

params.description: Merged stimulus params for this cell (injected as MATRIX_PARAM_*).

personaArm.description: contrast mode: which persona level this cell uses.

jobName.description: Harbor job name, filled after launch.
